subject: Request to Hold Promo Credits in Escrow for Hybrid Outreach - EventCo
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@eventco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: partners@eventco.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Holding credits in escrow for hybrid outreach activation

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EventCo is excited to run a joint hybrid outreach program with Redwood in Q1. Before we finalize the SOW we wanted to ask if Redwood can hold a pool of promo credits in escrow and release them in staged tranches tied to attendee milestones and performance KPIs.

High-level ask: can you hold 5,000 trial promo credits in escrow for EventCo (co-branded landing, attendee registration, and post-event onramp)? Proposed release schedule below: 
- Tranche A: 1,500 credits on landing page publish (T=0)
- Tranche B: 1,500 credits on 2,500 registrations
- Tranche C: 2,000 credits post-event within 14 days upon completion of the attendee list

We attached a draft SOW and a simple allocation sheet (EventCo_SOW_v3.pdf, credit_allocation_sheet.xlsx). We'll need a DocuSign SOW signature and a HubSpot deal record to track redemption.

A few constraints: we need a 90-day hold window (after which unused credits revert to Redwood), and we want redemption attribution tied to a utm_campaign and a parameter you can pass through the promo link. Also confirm whether we can split redemptions across regions (primarily US + EU).

Would you be able to confirm operational feasibility and any visibility we should provide (reporting cadence)? Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Partnerships, EventCo
+samantha.li@eventco.com | (415) 555-0194

Attachments: EventCo_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), credit_allocation_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holding credits in escrow for hybrid outreach activation

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. This is something we can likely support but I need to confirm a few operational and finance details. Quick notes / questions: 

1) Tranche breakdown: can you provide the exact redemption attribution tags (utm_campaign + utm_term or the promo token parameter) you want us to map? We need the final token strings to wire into our redemption engine.
2) Billing / value: please confirm whether the credits carry a monetary value on your side (we’ll need budget accountability for finance).
3) Region split: we can support US + EU redemptions; confirm which portion should be reserved for EU.
4) Reporting cadence: do you want weekly redemption reports or end-of-event summary? We can do either.

Cc'ing Marissa (partner ops) to scope the release automation and Monica (growth ops) for tagging and reporting. Marissa/Monica — can you flag any blockers (SLA, expiry, or accounting) on your side? Also will need a HubSpot deal ID to attach the allocation.

Happy to take a 20-minute call tomorrow to align if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com | (650) 555-0112

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Holding credits in escrow for hybrid outreach activation

FYI internal ops notes (quick):

- Escrow: We have a mechanism to put credits in an "escrow pool" tied to a deal tag. Legal signs off on pooled credits but finance needs an estimated liability value. Usually we require: total credits, assumed $/credit, hold window.
- Expiry: 90 days is fine; we'll set automatic revert to Redwood account after expiry.
- Attribution: we can honor utm tags OR a static promo token. Promo tokens are easier to validate server-side and prevent accidental reuse.
- EU redemptions: must ensure EU data residency if you plan to capture attendee PII during redemption; we can route EU redemptions to our EU region.
- Reporting: we can run a weekly CSV export to a shared Drive and provide an S3-reporting hook if EventCo needs programmatic access.

Action items for Rishi: please provide the HubSpot deal ID (or we can create one). Also confirm whether EventCo wants promo tokens or utm-based attribution — I'll draft the allocation sheet fields accordingly.

Attaching a working credit_allocation_sheet.xlsx (proposal) and a short checklist for finance.

-Marissa
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com

Thanks Rishi and team — apologies for the late reply, we finalized internal approvals. Answers below and notes: 

- Attribution: we'll use a promo token model. Please reserve the following tokens (each token equals 1 credit): EVCO-HYB-2027-A, EVCO-HYB-2027-B, EVCO-HYB-2027-C.
- Tranches (final): A = 1,500 (publish), B = 1,500 (2,500 registrations), C = 2,000 (post-event upload).
- EU split: Reserve 20% of each tranche for EU redemptions and route EU redemptions to the EU cluster.
- Billing: EventCo will cover promo credits as part of the cooperation budget. We'll sign the attached SOW today (DocuSign link below). Please estimate liability using $0.02/credit for now; finance will reconcile on invoicing.
- Reporting: weekly CSV + final attendee export post-event.
